doc.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004

title: Looking toward the year off: trio with Clarke and Ponty and a bluegrass band
summary: Fleck feels mixed excitement and fear about the break. He plans a trio with Stanley Clarke and Jean-Luc Ponty and a bluegrass trio, hoping to return with fresh ideas.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: That’s all right. You’ve got four dates to go and then is everybody looking forward to the time off do you think?

I think so. I think mixed, it’s like you never know, a whole year is a long time, you never know what’s going to happen so there’s always that wonder, you know, will we ever all be together like this again. But then again we’ve done it so much, we’ve played together so much so if something happened and for some reason it didn’t happen it wouldn’t be like the Flecktone experiment was a failure or something. We’ve done fifteen years. My thing is when we come back together I want it to be new and fresh and everybody to come back and want to really do it. And I don’t see any reason why that wouldn’t happen. I honestly don’t. But I’m looking forward to the things that I’m going to do and with mixed excitement and fear. Like I’ve got this trio I’m supposed to do. It’s Stanley Clarke and Jean Luc Ponty, which is going to be an interesting thing. I mean they’re great musicians but we’ve never played together and we’ve got all these big gigs coming up next summer and I don’t know what we’re going to sound like. So it’s exciting and frightening. And then I’m going to have a bluegrass band, a trio that I’m putting together also that I’m really looking forward to. I can’t see that being anything but fun. That’s what I thought was the only thing I was going to do this year is just play some bluegrass festivals and have a real light year but then this opportunity came into place and then all of a sudden it’s turning into a busy year. So it’ll be interesting.
So it won’t all be rest.

It won’t be rest, yeah, I don’t think it’ll be much rest. But I think it’ll be potentially a year where as a musician I would progress and then hopefully come back with some different ideas about how the Flecktones will go into the next period.
